projects.title: Nivora — Smart Homestay Booking & Travel Planning Platform
projects.summary: Web-based accommodation booking platform for discovering and booking homestays, villas, and apartments across popular travel destinations, with search, dashboards and an AI trip planner.
highlights: Property search and filtering by destination, check-in/check-out dates, guest count and accommodation preferences
Host and admin dashboards for listing management, reservation tracking, availability and dynamic pricing
AI-powered trip planning interface generating personalized itineraries and destination recommendations
Responsive UI, transparent pricing and a user-friendly booking experience

projects.title: Advanced Sudoku Solver
projects.summary: Zero-dependency browser Sudoku solver in vanilla JavaScript that handles 4x4, 9x9, 16x16 and 25x25 boards. Solve any grid with a backtracking algorithm, or photograph a printed puzzle and let the built-in Tesseract.js OCR scan the digits straight into the board.
highlights: Backtracking solver with per-cell constraint validation
Plain HTML/CSS/JS — about 470 lines, no build step

projects.title: Stock Price Predictor
projects.summary: Real-time trading-signal dashboard. A Python backend pulls 5-minute candles from yfinance, computes RSI, Bollinger Bands and Fibonacci retracement, then generates BUY/SELL signals with confidence scores and plain-English reasons every 5 seconds into Firebase Firestore — where a React 19 frontend renders live candlestick charts with TradingView lightweight-charts and instant ticker search.
highlights: Python signal engine: RSI (14), Bollinger Bands (20) and Fibonacci 61.8% levels
BUY / SELL signals scored 50–90 confidence with explained reasoning
Firestore realtime stream syncs backend loop to the browser chart
Candlestick chart with Fibonacci and Bollinger overlays (lightweight-charts)
Search any ticker from the UI; shared symbol config across clients

upcoming.title: SHAP Explainability Layer for MediCost AI
upcoming.summary: Adding SHAP (SHapley Additive Explanations) to MediCost AI so every prediction ships with per-feature contribution scores, visual explanations in the browser, and stakeholder-ready justification.

upcoming.title: Power BI Analytics Dashboard
upcoming.summary: Building a Power BI dashboard over the insured-risk dataset to turn model insights into executive-facing visual storytelling for insurance and finance teams.

upcoming.title: Insurance Agent Authentication Module
upcoming.summary: Adding secure agent login and profile-scoped analytics so that insurers can tag their own book of customers into MediCost AI and pull personalized segments.

upcoming.title: Docker + CI/CD Pipeline
upcoming.summary: Containerising MediCost AI with Docker and wiring a GitHub Actions pipeline that runs lint, unit tests, model smoke-tests, and auto-deploys on push.

upcoming.title: Model Monitoring & Drift Detection
upcoming.summary: Setting up a monitoring layer that logs every prediction, tracks prediction drift live, and raises alerts when the distribution of inputs shifts away from training data.

upcoming.title: LLM Insurance Support Companion
upcoming.summary: A conversational assistant that answers customer insurance questions, reads the predicted-cost explanation, and proactively suggests coverage-grade actions.

upcoming.title: AI Research Copilot with Source Verification
upcoming.summary: An AI assistant that reads PDFs, research papers and reports, answers questions from them with page-level citations, compares two papers and extracts their differences, flags unsupported claims and generates summaries. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, FastAPI, PostgreSQL with pgvector, an LLM API and Docker — with user accounts, saved documents and document history. Not just a chatbot: retrieval, backend APIs, databases and evaluation.
